prerequisites: Having completed the rest of the subjects that make up the Mathematics module (Algebra, Calculus, Differential Equations, and Advanced Calculus)
Knowledge of the LaTeX scientific text editor
Recall numerical methods studied in various subjects (numerical linear algebra, numerical solution of ordinary differential equations, linear regression, etc.)

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge on: linear algebra; geometry; differential geometry; differential and integral calculus; differential and partial differential equations; numerical methods; numerical algorithms; statistics and optimization.

syllabus_topics: Unit 0. Review of fundamental concepts (0.5 credits)
Finite arithmetic (used by computers) and numerical stability (which allows selecting valid algorithms).
Unit 1. Solutions of equations and systems (1.3 credits)
Basic direct methods for the numerical solution of a system of equations.
Error analysis or condition of a linear system.
Approximation of the integral of a function in an interval.
Unit 4. Numerical integration of ordinary differential equations. (1.3 credits)
Numerical solution of ODE systems (even of order greater than one)
teaching_methods: Specially prepared didactic materials for distance learning
Virtual course forums for questions and consultation
Work with Teaching Team (reading guidelines, consulting virtual course materials, reviewing and resolving doubts in forums)
Autonomous work (studying topics from the base text and other materials, solving problems)
Solving exercises from the base text
Using appropriate computer programs for numerical calculation (preprogrammed packages and student-developed code)

assessment_methods.method: Second Distance Learning Assessment (PED2) - Project with defense

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as: min { (Presential Exam Grade + 0.05 * PED1 Grade + 0.05 * PED2 Grade), 10 }. A final grade equal to or greater than 5 is essential to pass the course. The minimum grade on the final exam to allow the PED grades to be added is 4. Students who do not pass in June can present PED2 in September, and the June grade does not count in September.
